manual_user_activation: current route gap resolved by direct Hamish activation without erasing three historical failures

new_failures.failed_witness: A PowerShell reference-inventory wrapper placed a foreach statement directly before a pipe and was rejected before reading files.
new_failures.recovery: Materialized the foreach result in an array and piped that value only.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Materialize PowerShell collections before downstream formatting or filtering.

new_failures.failed_witness: A combined Git-log and receipt-search wrapper crossed its reporting window without an attributable completion object.
new_failures.recovery: Split exact Git history from bounded receipt enumeration and polled every returned session.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Keep revision, receipt, and recursive file searches as separate bounded probes.

new_failures.failed_witness: A worktree preflight embedded a semicolon-bearing Git invocation inside a Boolean expression and PowerShell rejected the missing closure.
new_failures.recovery: Ran branch existence, remote existence, and path existence as independent scalar probes.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Do not embed command sequences inside parenthesized Boolean projections.

new_failures.failed_witness: The first mechanical template projection materialized x2 and final builders before the planning-only x1 freeze.
new_failures.recovery: Stopped before staging and removed only the untracked files created by that attempt, leaving source and sibling state unchanged.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Create or materialize x2 and final builders only after the x1 commit is pushed and four-way equal.

new_failures.failed_witness: Direct npm website page reads returned HTTP 403 for five selected Node packages.
new_failures.recovery: Used the official npm registry command surface to resolve exact versions and deferred installation until x2.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Treat registry CLI metadata as the bounded fallback when the public package page denies automated reads.

new_failures.failed_witness: The optional Ruff x1 check could not resolve a Ruff executable from the active PATH despite historical inventory claims.
new_failures.recovery: Kept the already-passing compile unittest diff and privacy evidence, searched the bounded D-first tool roots without finding a callable Ruff binary, and deferred any isolated install to x2.
new_failures.recurrence_guard: Resolve an exact executable or isolated-environment module before invoking a historically catalogued tool; availability claims require a live path witness.
